title: Wrapper signal tests fail under the targeted test-suite runner
body:
Outcome: krn verify's targeted step passes on a head that changes test/isolation-gate.test.ts. 'SIGINT/SIGTERM of the test-suite wrapper stops its sleeping test child' fail with 'timed out waiting for sleeping test pid file' under node scripts/test-suite.mjs test/isolation-gate.test.ts at base 24ce843 and at head, while plain node --test passes (nested wrapper likely inherits the outer wrapper's env). Seen in t-jjjwvb1 verify (.krn/runs/lead/go-observer-capability/verify-1.log).
Proof: an observer runs the targeted runner on test/isolation-gate.test.ts and asserts both signal tests pass.
